title: Pay the Skilling Australians Fund levy when nominating a skilled visa worker
what: An employer nominating a worker for a skilled visa pays the nomination training contribution charge (s 140ZM of the Migration Act).

sources.title: Migration (Skilling Australians Fund) Charges Act 2018
sources.quote: 7 Imposition of nomination training contribution charge Nomination training contribution charge payable under section 140ZM of the Migration Act is imposed.
